sloka: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम् ।येन सर्वानरीन् वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसि ।। ६.१०७.३ ।।
transliteration: rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṁ sanātanam ।yena sarvānarīn vatsa samare vijayiṣyasi ।। 6.107.3 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed Sri Rama! Dear, hear this eternal secret (mantra) which will enable you to win all the enemies in war."
